title: Spacious | Cozy Home | FREE Parking | KING Bed
description:
Welcome to Music City Nashville! This LARGE & SPACIOUS home is located just 6 miles directly to Broadway. This retreat is a peaceful getaway with the excitement of downtown Nashville just minutes away. We provide our guests with an enhanced clean & well appointed stay that sleeps 9 guests in comfort. Perfect for bachelor/ bachelorette gatherings, family reunions, corporate retreats, and an overall great place to experience all aspects of Nashville. And 9 FREE ON SITE PARKING SPACES!!

The space
Thank you for your interest in Country Road Take Me Home to Nashville... with Hey Y'all Nashville!

WEEKEND RESERVATIONS:
Three night MINIMUM is required on all weekends. Friday and Saturday MUST be booked together.  Weekends are our most popular time in the city, which is why we require Friday and Saturday to be booked together. We have this rule due to the fact that it makes the other weekend night almost impossible to book if it is split up.

**Additional rules may apply for special events and holidays**

All natural, bright and warm tones flow throughout the home. You will enjoy the entire home of thoughtfully designed rooms and living spaces. The home boasts a large dining room that seats 8, kitchen area has bar height seating that sits 4, and a spacious living room with a queen sleeper sofa. The dining room also has a AWESOME PHOTO OPP selfie wall with "Music City" in lights and a FABULOUS Champagne Wall for your enjoyment and great PHOTO OPPS!
The Bedrooms are also large, spacious and comfortable. Each bedroom has a smart TV for those that like to wind down their day watching a show.
Both bathrooms are full bathrooms and are both located outside of the bedrooms for easy access for all to use.
There are 9 vanity stations set up throughout the home for ease of all getting ready and having your own personal space as well as offering a picture perfect opportunity for you and your guests to take more photos while creating memories to last a lifetime!

BEDROOM 1 FEATURES:
1 King Bed
Smart TV

BEDROOM 2 FEATURES:
1 King Bed
Smart TV

BEDROOM 3 FEATURES:
1 Queen Bed & 1 Twin XL Bed
Smart TV

LIVING ROOM / DEN:
1 Queen Sofa Bed with added padding for extra comfort
Smart TV

AMENITIES INCLUDE:
Free WiFi
Smart TV’s throughout the home (Living room & each Bedroom)
Fully equipped kitchen
Dining table with seating for 8
Bar Top Seating for 4
Washer & Dryer
Iron/Iron board
Hair dryer
Fresh bed linens
Plush towels
Toiletries - shampoo, conditioner, body soap, body lotion
Cozy pillows
Plenty of mirrors throughout for ease of getting ready
Dishwasher
Drip coffeemaker - coffee, creamer, sugar
Air-conditioning/heat

PARKING:
There are 9 onsite (off street) FREE PARKING SPACES.

ADDITIONAL ACCOMMODATIONS:
If this space is booked please feel free to inquire about our other accommodation options, you'll find that our properties are all professionally managed and well maintained. We'd love to host you!

CONCIERGE SERVICE:
Anything you need is at your fingertips with our concierge recommendations like stocking your fridge, luggage storage, decorating for your celebration or planning your itinerary! Let us make your trip to Nashville the best trip ever!

SECURITY DEPOSIT:
In certain circumstances we may ask for a refundable security deposit.

CLEANING:
We pride ourselves in providing a clean home for our guests. We hire cleaners that not only work hard, but take pride in their craft. They treat the property as their own and we pay them well for a thoroughly clean home. If during your stay, anything isn’t up to your standard please let us know immediately so that we can make it right for you right away. Your satisfaction is our top priority.

Permit number 2020 followed_by

Guest access
KEYLESS ENTRY:
Prior to your arrival, you will receive a unique keypad code that will serve as your keyless entry to the property during the length of your stay (check-in time at 4:00 pm and check-out at 11:00 am. Access is all keyless entry enabling you to come and go as you please.

GUIDE BOOK:
A book with recommendations for local restaurants, coffee shops, spas and other places to visit is provided in the property.

FREE PARKING:
Plenty of free parking directly behind the home.

Other things to note
RESPECT & CARE:
We have worked very hard to make your stay as comfortable as possible. Please respect, care and be mindful of the surrounding neighbors so that guests can continue to enjoy the space for many years to come.

EARLY CHECK IN/LATE CHECK OUT REQUESTS:
Our properties typically book every night and 100% of weekends. If you think you may need early check in or late check out please consider adding a night to the beginning or conclusion of your trip. Alternatively you can hire the local luggage holding service to hold your luggage before your check in or after your check out, if you are arriving early or departing late. 
Please DO NOT ask for an early check in or late check out unless it’s the day prior to your arrival or the day before check out. We are most happy to provide an exception as long as our cleaning crew indicates to us that your stay is ready for early check-in, we want everything "just right" and prefer not to rush our cleaning staff. 
On the same note, if you’re interested in one of our properties book it as soon as possible, we CAN NOT hold reservations and continuously correspond with groups who wanted accommodations that are no longer available.
